Class NodeList

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<Node>
java.util.AbstractList<Node>
java.util.ArrayList<Node>
threepl.nodes.NodeList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Iterable<Node>, Collection<Node>, List<Node>, RandomAccess, SequencedCollection<Node>, Constant
public final class NodeList extends ArrayList<Node> implements Constant
This class is just a convenient extension to ArrayList to handle lists of Nodes and enables us to get entries without needing a cast. It stores the source file location as well.

    • getIdent

      public Ident getIdent(int i, String mess)
      Get an argument identifier. The argument must be an identifier. It must not have subscripts or struct field identifiers appended or pre/post increment/decrement or examine operators. No maps are searched for this identifier. If the error message string header is null, errors return null rather than throwing an exception.
      Parameters:
      i - is the argument index
      mess - is string to be prepended to any error message
      Returns:
      the identifier

    • getIdent

      public Ident getIdent(int i, boolean allow_subs_fields_flags, String mess)
      Get an argument identifier. The argument must be an identifier. It must not have pre/post increment/decrement operators. No maps are searched for this identifier. If the error message string header is null, errors return null rather than throwing an exception.
      Parameters:
      i - is the argument index
      allow_subs_fields_flags - when true, skips the subscript/field check
      mess - is string to be prepended to any error message
      Returns:
      the identifier

    • sortKeys

      public void sortKeys(String mode, TreeMap<String,Integer> keys, boolean allowed_attributes, String name, boolean nullcheck, boolean isInput)
      Sort the nodes in this NodeList when keymatch arguments are present.
      Parameters:
      mode - is "module", "procedure" or "function" as appropriate and is used for exception text
      keys - is a map of expected keys and their parameter position in the list
      allowed_attributes - if true means that a key match argument may be an attribute assignment
      name - is the identifier of the module, procedure or function and is used for exception text
      nullcheck - if true check for null inputs (error)
      isInput - is true if this is an input node list
